text:
olivia: Quick ping — opened PR #3421 that adds VPC endpoints + an auth rotation hook for the on-prem agent. Need a security review for secrets handling and any on-prem implications. link: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/infra/pulls/3421
chad: Thanks — can you paste the key rotation flow here? curious about where the plaintext key material touches disk.
olivia: flow pasted below:
```
trigger -> rotation-service (KMS unwrap) -> write to /run/redwood/agent/creds (0600) -> agent picks up via inotify -> ephemeral in-memory load, delete file
```
sam: That flow looks okay but we need a threat note about attacker with node access. Does the agent also support HSM-backed keys or a KMS-only mode?
jia: Also add a small integration test that simulates rotation and ensures no file persisted >1s. We should assert file is deleted after load.
olivia: yep will add test. we currently have KMS-only mode; HSM planned but not in this PR. I'll add a TODO and a ticket for HSM.
chad: sec-bot scan? can you run local secret-scan before I approve?
sec-bot: Automated scan results for PR #3421 — secret scanning: 1 TODO comment detected (unmasked test secret in tests/agent/fixtures), dependency check: 0 critical, vulnerability summary: none blocking.
olivia: fixing the fixture now, will push a patch in ~15m.
sam: request — please add a short note in the PR description about on-prem network egress rules and what the VPC endpoints allow. we need that for compliance.
jia: also confirm rollout plan. If this merges to main, what is the canary window and rollback path?
olivia: plan: merge to main, deploy to staging with 10% canary for 30m, smoke checks (auth, rotation cron, agent heartbeat), then 1h full rollout. rollback: config flag to disable rotation hook + abort rollout via console.
chad: sounds fine. i'll hold approval until tests + fixture cleaned + PR description updated. after that — :thumbsup:
olivia: pushed fix for fixture and added test + PR description section for on-prem and compliance. backfill ticket for HSM: INF-878.
sec-bot: Scan re-run: no TODOs, secret-scan clear.
jia: LGTM pending one nit: move the `unlink()` to a finally block in the agent loader to ensure cleanup on exceptions.
sam: agree with jia, small change. after that i'm fine to approve.
chad: if jia and sam approve, i'm happy to merge tonight (fri 22:00 PT) — want a quiet window. tagging eng-sre for smoke-monitoring.
olivia: thanks all — I'll make the finally change and ping again when it's green.
sam: thanks.
chad: thanks :thumbsup:
